name: i&i Bio
decision_note: Prague-advised early-stage life-sciences VC (EUR 53m i&i Biotech Fund I SCSp, EIF-backed); led KyDo's seed (Sept 2025) and joined T-CURX's Series A and Captain T Cell's round in late 2025.

evidence.quote: Embedded in the innovative ecosystem around the Institute of Organic Chemistry and Biochemistry of the Czech Academy of Science, we are one of the very few VC funds in Europe focused exclusively on life science ventures.
As a life sciences fund, we are comfortable with drug discovery, medtech, diagnostics, and AI verticals.
Ready to create? We can start at €150k to support business creation.
Our sweet spot lies between €0.5M and €2M.
While our primary focus is on Central and Eastern Europe, we are open to collaborating with ambitious teams from all over the Europe.
With the participation of Česká spořitelna, i&i Bio's investment capital has significantly increased to a total of EUR 53 million.

The Series A syndicate was led by BiomedVC and included Bayern Kapital, WuXi Biologics Healthcare Ventures, HighLight Capital (HLC), and i&iBio Fund, as additional investors along with existing and new individual investors.

evidence.publisher: i&i Bio (Captain T Cell press release)
evidence.quote: Existing investors i&i Biotech Fund I SCSp, HIL-INVENT and Brandenburg Kapital also participated in the round.
The financing round is led by I&I Bio, with a significant investment from KHAN-II, and investments from VORNvc and TU capital.
i&i Biotech Fund (i&i Bio) je investiční fond, který splnil náročná kritéria Evropského investičního fondu (EIF) a zařadil se mezi více než 500 fondů podporovaných EIF.

analyst_notes: Structure: the fund vehicle is i&i Biotech Fund I SCSp (Luxembourg, 42 rue de la Vallée; RCS number not found, so registry_id null) and the press releases call i&i Bio 'a Luxembourg-based venture capital firm'; the team and the investment adviser Biotech Investments s.r.o. (IČO 10885978, Pobřežní 394/12, Praha 8, named as 'Investment Adviser' in the website footer, e10) are in Prague, so hq_country CZ and in pilot scope. The adviser's role is marked 'other' because the formal AIFM/GP of the SCSp was not identified. i&i Prague s.r.o. (IČO 06058485, same address) is the sponsoring biotech incubator, also 'other'. Capital: EUR 53m total fund commitments after Česká spořitelna's EUR 5m commitment (own release 2023-09-20; the homepage meta description repeats '€53M'); first close of >EUR 45m was announced 2021-02-23. Ticket EUR 150k (company creation) to EUR 2m sweet spot stated on the homepage; follow-on reserves for winners. A 2021 release mentioned an average EUR 2m and up to EUR 4.5m per project (older). Stage stated as company creation/early stage; observed participations also include Series A rounds (T-CURX, Delta Life Science). Investments: T-CURX USD 20m Series A first closing (i&i a participant); Captain T Cell round with i&i as existing investor - the release says 'available funding totaling EUR 20 million', which is not the round size, so round_amount left null; KyDo EUR 4.45m seed led by i&i (KyDo's own news page, dated 16 Sept 2025). The homepage portfolio table also lists Theorema (2026) without a dated source. Sector mapping: drug discovery -> biotech_life_sciences; medtech/diagnostics -> healthtech.
